requiredBeforeNative.filesystem: Root/inputs/proc/dev read-only; only fixed work/shm/device mounts; no inherited outside writable descriptors.
requiredBeforeNative.identity: Unique nonzero real host UID/GID; inspect NSS and bounded thread Uid/Gid/Groups; drop supplementary groups.
requiredBeforeNative.inputs: Authenticate exact controls, helpers, source/core inventories; fresh root must match expected rootfs.
requiredBeforeNative.namespaces: Same original host user namespace; distinct mount/pid/net/ipc/uts namespaces; no network or credentials.
requiredBeforeNative.privilege: Effective RestrictNamespaces=~user, active seccomp, no-new-privileges, all capability sets zero.
requiredBeforeNative.readback: Verify effective group/rlimit/mount byte-inode policies before native creation; refuse any mismatch.

requiredEvidence.completion: Exact service invocation/original client and all14 original phase, stream, configuration and persistence results.
requiredEvidence.failure: OOM/resource denial, mandatory-work error, timeout, cancellation, lost capture or uncertain finality remains failure.
requiredEvidence.owner: Existing original run_owned owner; unchanged common recipe endpoint, no per-phase reset.
requiredEvidence.retention: Checked bounded public allowlist before settled account deletion; no PID-snapshot or runner-disposal finality.
